p: Lloyd is in an open competition for the lead RB role.
Shares a muddled committee with Johnson and Brooks, so his role is volatile week to week.
I think everybody is in competition.
Lloyd is being built up to take a larger share of the carries.
The coach's confidence in Lloyd handling hits suggests his role in the backfield could grow.
Running backs need more opportunities, which depends on staying ahead of the sticks and moving the chains.
Backfield volume was limited (about 20 rushes), so RB opportunity depends on game script and offensive efficiency.
